adds.title: Iowa hate crime law and March 8, 2016 Senate bill
adds.summary: On March 8, 2016 the Iowa Senate voted 27-21 to pass a bill adding gender identity and gender expression to Iowa's hate crimes law to provide legal protection from hate crimes for transgender people, advancing the bill to the Iowa House of Representatives.

adds.title: SB 180 - Women's Bill of Rights (Kansas, 2023)
adds.summary: In February 2026 Kansas enacted SB 244 by overriding Governor Laura Kelly's veto to restrict bathrooms and locker rooms in public buildings including schools, universities, airports and government offices to sex assigned at birth, to roll back previously updated gender markers on driver's licenses and birth certificates, and to authorize bounty-style lawsuits for at least $1,000 by anyone claiming to have shared a bathroom with a transgender person.
